inputs.name: product direction and product requests from the Requesting Authority and from each company of the organisation
inputs.format: Work Item (ID + version), received through the HU input port at the tool gateway

inputs.name: the organisation's sources, such as its product documents, terms, policies and data, by reference only, from the output socket of Source Lifecycle
inputs.format: source reference (ID + version + hash; held or not held), received through the Input socket

inputs.name: signals from products in use: performance, customer voice, complaints and support
inputs.format: Work Item or record reference (ID + version), received through the tool gateway

inputs.name: questions, first-look builds and acceptance requests from the engineering AIOC on the product line
inputs.format: Work Item (ID + version), received through the tool gateway

outputs.name: complete product packages: the PRD, feature packages with acceptance criteria, designs for every state and copy in every language the product serves
outputs.format: frozen, content-addressed package (manifest + parts by hash), sent on the product line to the engineering AIOC through the tool gateway

outputs.name: answers to the engineering AIOC's questions, and acceptance of built work criterion by criterion
outputs.format: Work Item (ID + version), sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: prices, fees and rates as versioned data, each change with an effective date and a reason, and reversible
outputs.format: versioned record (ID + version), written through the tool gateway

outputs.name: explainers and supporting documents for each product: explainer and questions and answers, help articles, user guides, partner materials, internal training
outputs.format: versioned documents, filed into Source Lifecycle as sources

outputs.name: product reviews with their outcome: keep, fix, grow or retire
outputs.format: Work Item (ID + version), sent through the tool gateway

tool_roles: the product line to the engineering AIOC
source of record (the output socket of Source Lifecycle)
tool gateway (signatures, metering, the stop door)
